<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>Get a tracing account soft limit</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"get"} path={"/v1/account-management/consumption/tracing-accounts/{id}/soft-limit"}></MethodEndpoint>



Returns the current soft limit of a **Consumption** tracing account.

The soft limit caps the daily volume, in GB, that the tracing account is allowed to index. It is the same value as the account's `maxDailyGB`: these endpoints read and write that value.

Available for **Consumption** accounts only. If the account is not a Consumption account, the request returns `400`.

Please ensure to change the region in the URL to match your account's region.
